source_visual_observations: CircleO with center dot; Cleft on circle; Aupper-right andBlower-right; tangentsPA/PB; radiiOA/OB and chordsCA/CB; C65°.
audit.independent_solution: The inscribed angleACB=65° gives minor central angleAOB=130°. Radii at tangent points are perpendicular to the tangents, so angleAPB=360−90−90−130=50°, choice C.
